main_body: A thin dark iron lamp post (about 2px wide pole) with a T-shaped crossbar at the top, two hanging yellow lanterns, and a small grey stone base at the bottom.
top_band: none. The pole column is a 2px dark vertical line from row 5 to row 31. The crossbar is a 1-2 row dark line at rows 4-5. No lighter horizontal surface is visible.
evidence: The center column reads dark pole all the way down with no top surface. The crossbar is a 1-2px line and the lantern caps are tiny. The base is a small grey block with a lighter band at rows 34-35, but it is a plinth and does not count as the main body. The post is drawn as a flat front elevation with only a rim-thin cap at the top, so it fails the contract.

style.evidence: The pole is a flat dark 2px line with one tone and no grain. The crossbar is a single dark tone. The lanterns have about 3 yellow steps, but they are small. The base has some grey steps, but it is small. The outline and structure are near-black, neutral dark grey and sticker-like. Most tiles carry only 2-4 colours, far below the reference stall and well, which have rich texture, tinted outlines and 5-6 steps per material.
